WITH wrapper AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS w
), payload AS (
  SELECT convert_from(decode(w->>'b64', 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS p
  FROM wrapper
), required_columns(table_name, column_name) AS (
  VALUES
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'workflow_run_id'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'status'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'current_state'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'repository_full_name'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'current_phase'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'validation_verdict'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'final_pm_l2_evidence_ref'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'error_message'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'last_completed_step'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_runs', 'updated_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events', 'event_id'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events', 'workflow_run_id'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events', 'previous_state'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events', 'new_state'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events', 'event_type'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events', 'event_payload_json'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_run_events', 'created_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs', 'workflow_run_id'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs', 'step_name'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs', 'status'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs', 'attempt'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs', 'input_hash'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs', 'output_hash'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs', 'started_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs', 'completed_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs', 'error_message'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs', 'created_at'),
    ('moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs', 'updated_at')
), missing_columns AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table_name', rc.table_name, 'column_name', rc.column_name) ORDER BY rc.table_name, rc.column_name),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS missing
  FROM required_columns rc
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM information_schema.columns c
    WHERE c.table_schema = current_schema()
      AND c.table_name = rc.table_name
      AND c.column_name = rc.column_name
  )
), run_lookup AS (
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM moex_n8n_workflow_runs r
    WHERE to_jsonb(r)->>'workflow_run_id' = p->>'workflow_run_id'
  ) AS workflow_run_exists
  FROM payload
), decision AS (
  SELECT
    p,
    missing,
    workflow_run_exists,
    COALESCE((p->>'return_request_valid')::boolean, false) AS request_valid,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE((p->>'return_request_valid')::boolean, false) = false THEN 400
      WHEN jsonb_array_length(missing) > 0 THEN 400
      WHEN workflow_run_exists = false THEN 404
      ELSE 200
    END AS http_status_code
  FROM payload, missing_columns, run_lookup
), response_errors AS (
  SELECT
    p,
    missing,
    workflow_run_exists,
    request_valid,
    http_status_code,
    CASE
      WHEN request_valid = false THEN COALESCE(p->'errors', '[]'::jsonb)
      WHEN jsonb_array_length(missing) > 0 THEN COALESCE(p->'errors', '[]'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'postgres_schema_missing_expected_columns', 'field', 'postgres_schema', 'message', 'expected columns are missing', 'missing_columns', missing))
      WHEN workflow_run_exists = false THEN COALESCE(p->'errors', '[]'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code', 'workflow_run_not_found', 'field', 'workflow_run_id', 'message', 'workflow_run_id does not exist'))
      ELSE '[]'::jsonb
    END AS errors
  FROM decision
)
SELECT
  http_status_code,
  (http_status_code = 200) AS should_persist,
  CASE WHEN http_status_code = 200 THEN 'persist' ELSE 'respond_error' END AS route,
  p->>'workflow_run_id' AS workflow_run_id,
  p->>'request_id' AS request_id,
  p->>'repository_full_name' AS repository_full_name,
  p->>'source_role' AS source_role,
  p->>'return_to_role' AS return_to_role,
  p->>'return_type' AS return_type,
  p->>'validation_status' AS validation_verdict,
  (SELECT w::text FROM wrapper) AS pg_parameter_string,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'workflow_name', 'MOEX_ROUTE_B_PM_L3_RETURN_INTAKE_V1_10_3',
    'spec_version', '1.10.3',
    'http_status_code', http_status_code,
    'accepted', false,
    'return_request_valid', request_valid,
    'workflow_run_id', p->>'workflow_run_id',
    'request_id', p->>'request_id',
    'repository_full_name', p->>'repository_full_name',
    'source_role', p->>'source_role',
    'return_to_role', p->>'return_to_role',
    'return_type', p->>'return_type',
    'status', CASE WHEN http_status_code = 404 THEN 'not_found' ELSE 'invalid_request' END,
    'current_state', NULL,
    'current_phase', NULL,
    'validation_verdict', p->>'validation_status',
    'pm_l2_review_required', false,
    'event_type', NULL,
    'event_ref', NULL,
    'final_pm_l2_evidence_ref', NULL,
    'blockers', COALESCE(p->'blockers', '[]'::jsonb),
    'required_fixes', COALESCE(p->'required_fixes', '[]'::jsonb),
    'authority_boundary', COALESCE(p->'authority_boundary', '{}'::jsonb),
    'errors', errors
  ) AS response
FROM response_errors;

WITH wrapper AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS w
), payload AS (
  SELECT convert_from(decode(w->>'b64', 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS p
  FROM wrapper
), prepared AS (
  SELECT
    p,
    p->>'workflow_run_id' AS workflow_run_id,
    p->>'request_id' AS request_id,
    p->>'repository_full_name' AS repository_full_name,
    p->>'source_role' AS source_role,
    p->>'return_to_role' AS return_to_role,
    p->>'return_type' AS return_type,
    p->>'validation_status' AS validation_status,
    NULLIF(p->>'blocker_summary', '') AS blocker_summary,
    md5(p::text) AS input_hash
  FROM payload
), prior AS (
  SELECT
    r.workflow_run_id,
    r.current_state AS previous_state
  FROM moex_n8n_workflow_runs r
  JOIN prepared pr ON r.workflow_run_id = pr.workflow_run_id
), event_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO moex_n8n_workflow_run_events (
    workflow_run_id,
    previous_state,
    new_state,
    event_type,
    event_payload_json,
    created_at
  )
  SELECT
    pr.workflow_run_id,
    prior.previous_state,
    'pm_l2_review_required',
    'pm_l3_return_received',
    pr.p,
    now()
  FROM prepared pr
  JOIN prior ON prior.workflow_run_id = pr.workflow_run_id
  RETURNING event_id::text AS event_id,
            workflow_run_id,
            ('postgres://moex_n8n_workflow_run_events/' || event_id::text) AS event_ref
), run_update AS (
  UPDATE moex_n8n_workflow_runs r
  SET
    status = 'pm_l2_review_required',
    current_state = 'pm_l2_review_required',
    current_phase = 'pm_l3_return_completed',
    validation_verdict = pr.validation_status,
    final_pm_l2_evidence_ref = ev.event_ref,
    error_message = CASE WHEN pr.validation_status IN ('fail', 'blocked') THEN pr.blocker_summary ELSE NULL END,
    last_completed_step = 'pm_l3_return_intake',
    updated_at = now()
  FROM prepared pr
  JOIN event_insert ev ON ev.workflow_run_id = pr.workflow_run_id
  WHERE r.workflow_run_id = pr.workflow_run_id
  RETURNING r.workflow_run_id
), step_hashes AS (
  SELECT
    pr.workflow_run_id,
    pr.input_hash,
    md5((pr.p || jsonb_build_object('event_ref', ev.event_ref, 'final_pm_l2_evidence_ref', ev.event_ref, 'status', 'pm_l2_review_required', 'current_state', 'pm_l2_review_required', 'current_phase', 'pm_l3_return_completed'))::text) AS output_hash
  FROM prepared pr
  JOIN event_insert ev ON ev.workflow_run_id = pr.workflow_run_id
), step_update AS (
  UPDATE moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs s
  SET
    status = 'completed',
    attempt = COALESCE(s.attempt, 1),
    input_hash = sh.input_hash,
    output_hash = sh.output_hash,
    completed_at = now(),
    updated_at = now(),
    error_message = NULL
  FROM step_hashes sh
  WHERE s.workflow_run_id = sh.workflow_run_id
    AND s.step_name = 'pm_l3_return_intake'
  RETURNING s.workflow_run_id
), step_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs (
    workflow_run_id,
    step_name,
    status,
    attempt,
    input_hash,
    output_hash,
    started_at,
    completed_at,
    error_message,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    sh.workflow_run_id,
    'pm_l3_return_intake',
    'completed',
    1,
    sh.input_hash,
    sh.output_hash,
    now(),
    now(),
    NULL,
    now(),
    now()
  FROM step_hashes sh
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM step_update su WHERE su.workflow_run_id = sh.workflow_run_id)
  RETURNING workflow_run_id
)
SELECT
  202 AS http_status_code,
  true AS accepted,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'workflow_name', 'MOEX_ROUTE_B_PM_L3_RETURN_INTAKE_V1_10_3',
    'spec_version', '1.10.3',
    'http_status_code', 202,
    'accepted', true,
    'return_request_valid', true,
    'workflow_run_id', pr.workflow_run_id,
    'request_id', pr.request_id,
    'repository_full_name', pr.repository_full_name,
    'source_role', pr.source_role,
    'return_to_role', pr.return_to_role,
    'return_type', pr.return_type,
    'status', 'pm_l2_review_required',
    'current_state', 'pm_l2_review_required',
    'current_phase', 'pm_l3_return_completed',
    'validation_verdict', pr.validation_status,
    'pm_l2_review_required', true,
    'event_type', 'pm_l3_return_received',
    'event_ref', ev.event_ref,
    'final_pm_l2_evidence_ref', ev.event_ref,
    'blockers', COALESCE(pr.p->'blockers', '[]'::jsonb),
    'required_fixes', COALESCE(pr.p->'required_fixes', '[]'::jsonb),
    'authority_boundary', COALESCE(pr.p->'authority_boundary', '{}'::jsonb),
    'errors', '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS response
FROM prepared pr
JOIN event_insert ev ON ev.workflow_run_id = pr.workflow_run_id
JOIN run_update ru ON ru.workflow_run_id = pr.workflow_run_id;
